reasons: Not used consistently; several screens type raw icon names.

terms.meaning: a free icon library that comes with Expo, identified by text names.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Setup for the icon list
sections.what: A header comment saying this file is the single place for icon names.
sections.why: Likely reason: makes the purpose of the file clear.

sections.name: Icons (part 1)
sections.title: Navigation, action, health and people icons
sections.what: Gives short names to icons for navigation, common actions, health topics and people. Each name points to an Ionicons icon.
sections.why: Likely reason: screens use a short name rather than a long icon name.
sections.watch_out: A name that does not exist in Ionicons shows as blank with no error.

sections.name: Icons (part 2)
sections.title: Misc icons and the brand icon
sections.what: Adds short names for settings, security, alerts, sharing, and the leaf icon used as the app's brand mark.
sections.why: Likely reason: same as the list above.

summary: A list of short, friendly names that each point to a real icon name.
purpose: Keeps icon names in one place so they are easy to change.
why: Likely reason: changing an icon name in one place updates every screen that uses it.
how: Groups the names into navigation, actions, health, people and misc. The list is locked so its values cannot change at runtime.
risks: A wrong icon name shows as a blank icon with no error. Many screens still type raw icon names directly, so this list is not the only source.
debug: If an icon is blank, check the value against the Ionicons name list. If an icon looks wrong, check whether the screen uses this list or a raw name.
